{{E|The Nest}} is an event found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Smash and Grab}} {{TS|positive||Obtain 99 {{Asc|15|(50)}} Gold.}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Stay in Line}} {{TS|positive||Obtain {{C|Ritual Dagger}}.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 6 HP.}}

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
A long line of {{TS|blue|up|hooded figures}} can be seen entering an {{TS|purple||unassuming cathedral.}}
</div><br>
<div style="font-style:italic">
Naturally, you join the line and are quickly surrounded by {{TS|negative||Cultists!}} <br>
They ignore you as they gleefully {{TS||shake|chant}} and {{TS||up|wave}} their weapons around. <br>

{{TS|negative|shake|"MURDER!! MURDER MURDER!!"}} <br>
{{TS|blue|up|"CAW CAW CAAAAAWWW!"}} <br>
{{TS|negative|shake|"MURDER! MURDER MURDER!!"}} <br>
{{TS|blue|up|"CAAW CAW CAAAAAAWW!!"}} <br>

You eye a {{TS|gold||Donation Box...}}
</div>

{{Frame|Smash and Grab}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
They didn't even notice.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Stay in Line}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You decide to stay in line (out of fear) to see what will happen. <br>

Eventually, you are face-to-face with the leader. A well-dressed cultist hands you an {{TS|gold||Ornate Dagger.}} Like the others before you, you slash your forearm and let the blood drip into a misshapen bowl. <br>

The cultists {{TS||shake|chant}} and {{TS||shake|holler}} for you! <br>

{{TS|blue|up|"CAAW CAW CAAAAAAWW!!"}} <br>

You chant, too. Why not?
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* {{E|The Nest}} depicts many aspects of the cult of the {{M|Awakened One}} that is encountered throughout the Spire. The {{M|Cultist|Cultists}} waiting in line, the "well-dressed cultist" could be a {{M|Chosen}}, and the {{C|Ritual Dagger}} is identical to the one that can be seen sticking out of the {{M|Awakened One}}'s chest.
* Internally called <code>Nest</code>.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 37: Darkness'''
** an -> a typo in the Nest event.
* '''Weekly Patch 29: TURBO'''
** In the Nest event, you receive the dagger for 6 damage instead of a downgrade now.
** In the Nest event, the non-dagger option steals less gold now (150 -> 99). Ascension 15 -> 50.
* '''Weekly Patch 28: The Ritual'''
** New Act 2 event: The Nest
** New Card: Ritual Dagger
